description: Deliberately grants no updater plugin permission: the official GitHub channel (endpoints + minisign key from tauri.conf.json plugins.updater) is only reachable through the app-owned check_native_update / install_native_update commands, which enforce the updates feature gate first. The plugin stays registered for Rust-side use. Restart uses the app-owned restart_app command (no process plugin permission). This file also binds the main window label.
